name: Generator (NeRF Wrapper with Latent Code & Near/Far Adjustment)
definition: Wraps a NeRF network to render rays conditioned on a latent code z, handling camera pose sampling, ray generation, and dynamic near/far plane adjustment for variable radii.
summary: This NeRF wrapper renders images conditioned on a latent code while dynamically adjusting near and far clipping planes based on camera distance.
